node.label: Badminton
node.summary: Indian badminton players and tournament results.

facts.text: Tanvi Patri won badminton silver at the Dakar Youth Olympics, losing the final to World junior champion Zhang Yi Xin of China 21-15, 13-21, 24-26.
facts.plain: Tanvi Patri won badminton silver at the Dakar Youth Olympics, losing the final to World junior champion Zhang Yi Xin of China 21-15, 13-21, 24-26.

facts.text: **P.B. Abhinandh and Divyanshi Bhowmick** became the World No. 1 pair in the under-19 mixed-doubles badminton rankings.
facts.plain: P.B. Abhinandh and Divyanshi Bhowmick became the World No. 1 pair in the under-19 mixed-doubles badminton rankings.

facts.text: **Lakshya Sen** beat Indonesia's **Jonatan Christie** 21-17, 21-10 in the Hylo Open final, his first title of 2026 and second Hylo Open.
facts.plain: Lakshya Sen beat Indonesia's Jonatan Christie 21-17, 21-10 in the Hylo Open final, his first title of 2026 and second Hylo Open.

facts.text: **P.V. Sindhu** and **Lakshya Sen** won the women's and men's singles titles at the Hylo Open Super 500 (Saarbrucken, Germany) with straight-games final wins — Sindhu's title adds to her earlier Japan Open win this year, and Lakshya ended a title drought.
